idea-plugin.name: Flink Pipeline Preview
idea-plugin.description:
Shows the Apache Flink DataStream pipeline built by the Java code you are editing as a live graph.

  • Static analysis of DataStream API call chains (Flink 1.x and 2.x, including the DataStream V2 API)
  • Follows local variables, reassignments, helper methods, unions, connects, side outputs and broadcasts
  • Click a node to jump to its code; the node under the caret is highlighted
